tiers.0: System (green). Peer-to-peer announcements and system notifications.
tiers.1: Alert (yellow). Minor issue; address after the race or with small driving changes.
tiers.2: Warning (orange). Moderate issue; address at the next stop or change driving now.
tiers.3: Emergency (red). Major issue; stop and address immediately.

rules.title: Dead battery
rules.message: Battery is below the minimum threshold. Charge or replace.

rules.title: Low battery
rules.message: Battery voltage is dropping. Swap or charge at the next stop.

rules.title: Transmission hot
rules.message: Ease off and plan a cool-down at the next stop.

rules.title: Transmission overheating
rules.message: Stop and let the transmission cool before continuing.

rules.title: Engine over-rev
rules.message: Primary RPM is above the governed limit. Check CVT tuning.

rules.title: Close to tipping
rules.message: Car came near its rollover limit. Check the driver's line and speed through that section.

rules.title: Possible rollover
rules.message: Car reached its tipping point or is on its side. Check on the driver now.
